summary: Rei Hwa Lee, 57, of Littleton, found dead at 12,600 feet on the north face of North Maroon Peak; assumed fall while hiking solo
notes: Found Aug 8; Denver Post roundup dates the fall to Aug 5; hiking solo Alpine mission 2017-83: paged 08/08/17 15:01 for assist to Mountain Rescue Aspen in the Maroon Bells search — same incident. SnowBrains merge run 885: Rei Hwa Lee's body spotted 2017-08-08 on the north face ~12,600'; recovered by two Mountain Rescue Aspen members + a HAATS Blackhawk team and flown to the Aspen/Pitkin airport.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (North Maroon Peak)
